question.text: A trader buys 3 lots of EURINR futures at 89.50. The settlement price is 88.75. What is the MTM amount?

explanation.text: The Logic: A long futures position loses when the settlement price falls below the entry price. MTM = (Settlement - Entry) x Lot size x Lots = (88.75 - 89.50) x 1000 x 3 = -0.75 x 3000 = -Rs. 2,250, i.e. a loss of Rs. 2,250. The Trap: EURINR has a unit of trading of 1000 Euro, the same lot size as USDINR; treating it as larger or smaller will give the wrong value. Note: Daily MTM uses the exchange-published daily settlement price for the contract.
